notes.title: Castle Flipper - Premiere
notes.content:

•	[b]Stream[/b] that should start in few moments

notes.title: Game Announcement and Question to Community
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Celebrities![/h1]

Today we have announced our new game: [b][u]Celebrity Life[/u][/b]
It's a HUGE task. We are more then delighted to forge our idea and Your dreams to Code and Game!

Part of [b]Gaming Factory[/b] Credo is to create a game altogether with its community so we would like to ask You a question:

[h3][b]"[u]What kind of Celebrity would You like to become in our game[/u]?"[/b][/h3]

You can post Your answers here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1459990/discussions/0/2987537248821542207/
Or on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/GTyR9ZC]Discord Server.[/url]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/GTyR9ZC][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39149589/34ca32c4fa77b7c22e3ca3fa6c486464fd95fe33.png[/img][/url]

Our goal is to create a game that will be reviewable just as [b]Dave Chappelle[/b] once said:
"[i]I love being famous - it's phenomenal.[/i]"

[b]But for now, stay tuned for more awesome stuff on our Discord or Social Media![/b]
https://linktr.ee/GamingFactorySA

Don't forget to Add [b]Celebrity Life[/b] to [b]Your Wishlist[/b] ;)
